story.title: The Shadow Weight
story.logline: A young woman realizes her shadow refuses to follow her movements, revealing it has a life and agenda of its own.
story.twist: The shadow isn't copying her; she is the one trapped copying the shadow's movements.
story.ending: Who is actually standing in the light right now?

scenes.narration: My shadow just took a step while my feet were completely glued to the cold kitchen floor.
scenes.visual_prompt: Maya, 22, short dark hair, wearing a grey oversized hoodie, standing in a brightly lit modern kitchen.
scenes.camera: Vertical medium shot, locked off on the floor and her boots.

scenes.narration: I watched in absolute terror as my dark silhouette raised an arm I had not lifted.
scenes.visual_prompt: Maya, 22, short dark hair, grey hoodie, staring down in horror at the kitchen tile.
scenes.camera: Vertical low angle looking up at her terrified face.

scenes.narration: Panic seized my chest. I backed away from the overhead light, needing distance from the floor.
scenes.visual_prompt: Maya, 22, short dark hair, grey hoodie, stumbling backward against a white apartment wall.
scenes.camera: Vertical tracking shot moving with her retreat.

scenes.narration: The shadow detached itself from the baseboard, sliding smoothly across the room toward the dark hallway.
scenes.visual_prompt: Maya, 22, short dark hair, grey hoodie, watching a dark floor-bound shape detach and move.
scenes.camera: Vertical wide shot of the hallway entrance.

scenes.narration: I followed it because stopping felt even more dangerous than walking into the unknown darkness.
scenes.visual_prompt: Maya, 22, short dark hair, grey hoodie, stepping hesitantly into a dimly lit corridor.

scenes.narration: It stopped by the front door, waiting patiently with its hand curled around the brass handle.
scenes.visual_prompt: Maya, 22, short dark hair, grey hoodie, standing in a dark hallway facing a front door.
scenes.camera: Vertical medium shot framing her and the door.

scenes.narration: When the shadow twisted the lock, my own fingers suddenly snapped to imitate the exact motion.
scenes.visual_prompt: Maya, 22, short dark hair, grey hoodie, her hand violently twitching to match the shadow's action.
scenes.camera: Vertical close-up on her hands at the lock.

scenes.narration: The heavy front door swung open wide, letting blinding daylight flood into the gloomy apartment.
scenes.visual_prompt: Maya, 22, short dark hair, grey hoodie, blinking hard as bright sunlight pours through the open door.
scenes.camera: Vertical wide shot facing the bright doorway.

scenes.narration: I stepped outside into the street, only to realize the sun was behind me the whole time.
scenes.visual_prompt: Maya, 22, short dark hair, grey hoodie, standing on a bright city sidewalk, looking down.
scenes.camera: Vertical tracking shot from behind her.

scenes.narration: If the sun is at my back, why is my shadow standing right in front of me?
scenes.visual_prompt: Maya, 22, short dark hair, grey hoodie, staring straight ahead at a dark figure standing opposite her.
scenes.camera: Vertical extreme close-up on her wide, terrified eyes.

caption.title: The Shadow Weight
caption.caption:
She thought her silhouette had finally broken free from her control. But a terrifying realization hit in the dark: she was the one trapped in the echo.

Are you sure you are the one in control?
